critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the upper deck cylinder primitive to create a more prominent 'hump' by increasing its length along the longitudinal axis by 50% (extending further toward the rear), increasing its vertical offset from the main fuselage by 30%, and applying a gradual height taper of -20% from front to back. To improve aerodynamics, round the leading edge of this primitive with a 15-degree fillet radius where it meets the nose section.

discrepancies.observed: The upper deck section is very short and ends abruptly near the front.
discrepancies.reference: A long, distinct 'hump' that extends significantly back along the forward fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Increase length of the upper deck cylinder towards the rear.

discrepancies.observed: The hump is relatively low and blends into the main fuselage quickly.
discrepancies.reference: A prominent, elevated section that sits high above the main cabin line.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Increase vertical offset of the upper deck geometry.

discrepancies.observed: The transition from the nose to the hump is sharp and angular.
discrepancies.reference: A smooth, continuous aerodynamic curve blending the cockpit into the upper deck.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Smooth/round the front edge of the upper deck primitive.

discrepancies.observed: The top surface of the hump appears flat or lacks a gradual downward slope toward the rear.
discrepancies.reference: A graceful tapering down from the peak of the hump towards the mid-fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Decrease height of the upper deck primitive gradually as it moves backward.
